title: YouTube AdFree
appDescription: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. DEV revision 9 retires the ineffective standalone isAdPlayback=true mutation while retaining isAdPlayback observation, upgrades the on-TV report to diagnostics v6 with privacy-safe outbound playback-request instrumentation for isInlinePlaybackNoAd, and broadens Remove Shorts handling for direct renderer/view-model reel navigation, direct Shorts content/style enums, and Shorts startup behaviours. Every Shorts removal remains controlled by the existing Remove Shorts setting.
